name: homecastr-mcp-server

tools.name: forecast_by_address
tools.description: Get probabilistic home value forecasts for a US street address. Returns P10/P50/P90 bands, appreciation %, reliability score, and 5-year fan chart. Best coverage: Houston metro area.

address.description: US street address, e.g. '5000 Westheimer Rd Houston TX 77056'

tools.name: forecast_by_parcel
tools.description: Get lot-level probabilistic forecasts by county tax parcel account number. Coverage: Florida statewide + Houston metro. Returns P10/P25/P50/P75/P90 fan chart across 1-5 year horizons.

acct.description: County tax parcel account number. Florida: dash-separated (e.g. '00404328020003500'). Houston HCAD: 10-13 digits.

tools.name: forecast_by_tabblock
tools.description: Get sub-neighborhood probabilistic forecasts by US Census tabulation block GEOID20 (15 digits). Coverage: NYC (32K tabblocks) and Houston metro (34K tabblocks). Highest geographic resolution available.

geoid.description: 15-digit Census GEOID20. NYC example: '360050002000001'. Houston example: '480717106001022'.

tools.name: forecast_by_tract
tools.description: Get neighborhood-level probabilistic forecasts by US Census tract GEOID20 (11 digits). Coverage: Florida + Houston via jurisdiction model; all ~82K US tracts via ACS nationwide model. Use for cross-market analysis.

geoid.description: 11-digit Census tract GEOID20. Houston example: '48201231400'. Manhattan: '36061023100'. Miami: '12086000100'.

tools.name: forecast_by_zcta
tools.description: Get ZIP-level probabilistic forecasts by 5-digit ZCTA. Coverage: ~20,000 ZCTAs nationwide via ACS model with 6-year horizon (0-72 months). Use for quick cross-market ZIP-level comparisons.

zcta.description: 5-digit ZCTA / ZIP code. Examples: '77056' (Houston), '10001' (Manhattan), '94110' (SF Mission), '60614' (Chicago Lincoln Park), '33101' (Miami), '98101' (Seattle).

tools.name: forecast_by_unit
tools.description: Get individual unit-level forecasts by assessor account number. This is the finest resolution available; covers individual condo units, SFRs, and townhouses. Use include_siblings=true to get all units in the same condo building. Coverage: Florida statewide + Houston metro.

acct.description: Assessor account number. FL DOR: '00404328020003500'. Houston HCAD: 10-13 digit account.

include_siblings.description: If true and unit is a condo, also return all sibling units in the same building (condo_group). Default: false.

tools.name: forecast_by_county
tools.description: Get county-level probabilistic forecasts by 5-digit FIPS code. Nationwide coverage. Use for market-level analysis or when you have a county FIPS but not a specific parcel.

fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS (state 2 + county 3). Harris County TX=48201, LA County=06037, Manhattan=36061, Miami-Dade=12086, Cook County IL=17031, King County WA=53033.

tools.name: forecast_by_state
tools.description: Get state-level probabilistic forecasts by 2-digit FIPS code. All 50 US states covered. Use for macro market comparison or top-of-funnel market selection.

fips.description: 2-digit state FIPS. TX=48, FL=12, NY=36, CA=06, IL=17, WA=53, TX=48. Get all states by calling retrieve_all() in the Python SDK.

tools.name: forecast_by_zip3
tools.description: Get ZIP3-level forecasts (first 3 digits of ZIP code). 6,210 areas nationwide. Good mid-size geography between ZIP and county for regional market comparisons.

zip3.description: First 3 digits of ZIP code. Houston=770, Manhattan=100, Miami=331, Chicago=606, SF=941, Seattle=981, LA=900, Boston=021.

tools.name: forecast_by_h3_cell
tools.description: Get neighborhood-level forecasts by H3 hex cell ID at resolution 8. Houston metro only. Prefer forecast_by_tabblock or forecast_by_tract for new integrations.

h3_id.description: H3 cell ID at resolution 8, e.g. '882a100c65fffff'

tools.name: list_benchmark_datasets
tools.description: List Homecastr benchmark and public-data assets. Returns release phase, support level, benchmark role, and the recommended public surface for each asset.

phase.description: Optional release phase filter. Common values: phase_1, phase_2, phase_3, hold.

asset_class.description: Optional asset class filter. Common values: forecast_outputs, backtest_vintage_outputs, benchmark_panels, provenance_manifests, holdback_assets.

public_readiness.description: Optional readiness filter. Values: launch, draft, hold.

tools.name: get_benchmark_dataset
tools.description: Get the catalog entry for one Homecastr public-data or benchmark asset by asset_id. Use this to discover the right REST path before calling vintages, backtests, or source manifests.

tools.name: get_public_forecast_vintage
tools.description: Retrieve validated public forecast vintage rows, starting with the Arizona OEO Maricopa 2022 county-control fixture. Every row carries provenance and benchmark-only labeling.

tools.name: get_backtest_scores
tools.description: Retrieve public-safe benchmark score summaries such as model-vs-persistence tables. Returns asset IDs, artifact IDs, model version labels, and per-target score rows.

tools.name: list_data_assets
tools.description: List the canonical Homecastr data-asset catalog across public, metadata-only, restricted, and unavailable rows. Use this to discover the full standardized surface, not just currently launched endpoints.

data_family.description: Optional family filter such as 'forecast_output', 'input_panel', 'source_metadata', or 'provenance_manifest'.

public_status.description: Optional public status filter such as 'launch', 'draft', 'metadata_only', 'hold', or 'not_public'.

visibility.description: Optional visibility filter such as 'public', 'metadata_only', 'restricted', or 'unavailable'.

inventory_asset.description: Optional public-data inventory asset filter such as 'forecast.aggregate_surfaces' or 'benchmark.normalized_training_panels_candidate'.

tools.name: get_data_asset
tools.description: Get one canonical data-asset record by asset_id. Returns surface coverage, canonical contracts, provenance, access policy, and related artifact or provenance links.

asset_id.description: Canonical data asset identifier, e.g. 'forecast.tract_home_value' or 'context.census_acs'.

tools.name: list_data_sources
tools.description: List original data sources used, staged, or reviewed for Homecastr panels. Returns official outbound source URLs, source tier, source status, panel links, license status, and public readiness.

source_id.description: Optional exact source identifier such as 'census.acs.county_5yr' or 'az.mag_2023_official_mpa_raz_taz_projections'.

data_family.description: Optional source-family filter such as 'assessor_tax', 'hazard_context', 'permits', or 'mag_public_projection_and_planning_surfaces'.

source_status.description: Optional status filter such as 'used', 'candidate', 'blocked', or 'mentioned'.

public_readiness.description: Optional readiness filter such as 'metadata_public', 'metadata_public_raw_hold', or 'summary_public_rows_missing'.

license_status.description: Optional license or policy filter such as 'public_source_reviewed', 'public_source_metadata_only', or 'source_specific_review_required'.

panel_id.description: Optional canonical panel filter such as 'panel.acs_nationwide' or 'panel.az_maricopa_mag_multires_enriched'.

tools.name: get_data_source
tools.description: Get one original data source by source_id, including official outbound URLs, source family, panel links, provenance metadata, and access policy.

source_id.description: Canonical source identifier such as 'source.hcad_houston.assessor' or 'census.building_permits.county_month'.

tools.name: get_panel_lineage
tools.description: Get the source-to-panel lineage for a canonical panel. Returns source roles, join keys, transforms, output fields, and official source URLs.

panel_id.description: Canonical panel identifier such as 'panel.acs_nationwide' or 'panel.az_maricopa_mag_multires_enriched'.

source_id.description: Optional source identifier filter for one lineage edge or source family member.

tools.name: get_data_coverage
tools.description: Summarize source, panel, source-to-geography index, and coverage-map posture across the source inventory. Returns counts by tier, status, family, geography, resolution, license status, panel lineage, coverage geometry role, native-boundary status, and top coverage-map regions.

tools.name: list_source_coverage_index
tools.description: List source-to-coverage geography index rows. Returns one row per source with coverage feature IDs, declared geography, coverage geometry role, reference boundary IDs/names when available, native-boundary review status, official URLs, and geometry redistribution policy.

source_id.description: Optional exact source identifier such as 'az.maricopa_parcels'.

coverage_feature_id.description: Optional coverage-map feature identifier such as 'coverage.arizona_phoenix_maricopa_pinal'.

source_family.description: Optional source-family filter such as 'maricopa_assessor_parcels' or 'assessor_tax'.

coverage_geometry_role.description: Optional coverage geometry role such as 'reference_boundary' or 'generalized_selection_region'.

native_boundary_status.description: Optional native-boundary status such as 'native_boundary_candidate_terms_review_required' or 'reference_boundary_join_required'.

license_status.description: Optional license or policy status filter.

tools.name: list_public_records_acquisition
tools.description: List metadata-only public-records acquisition evidence lanes. Returns durable cloud evidence, public-route checks, records-law gate posture, holdbacks, and next safe action without exposing raw payloads or send-ready request copy.

lane_id.description: Optional exact acquisition lane identifier such as 'georgia_permit_public_routes'.

source_family.description: Optional source-family filter such as 'utility_energy_infrastructure' or 'assessor_tax'.

geography.description: Optional geography token filter such as 'US-FL-Orange' or 'US-AZ-Maricopa'.

current_status.description: Optional acquisition status filter such as 'public_r2_partial_downstream_screen_complete'.

records_law_gate.description: Optional request-gate posture such as 'closed_no_send_ready_candidate' or 'draft_only_no_live_request'.

tools.name: get_source_coverage_map
tools.description: Return the public source coverage GeoJSON layer used by the interactive docs map. Features carry public reference boundaries or generalized selection regions, associated source IDs, official upstream URLs, panel links, readiness, license metadata, and geometry notes.

tools.name: list_data_schemas
tools.description: List canonical Homecastr schema contracts from the public schema bundle. Use this to discover dataset, provenance, panel, forecast, benchmark, and artifact contract IDs.

data_family.description: Optional family filter such as 'forecast_output' or 'training_panel'.

schema_id.description: Optional canonical schema filter such as 'hc.dataset_asset.v1' or 'hc.panel_row.v1'.

tools.name: get_data_schema
tools.description: Get one canonical schema definition by schema_id, including its JSON Schema definition and the data families or assets that reference it.

tools.name: get_entity
tools.description: Get canonical metadata for one geography entity such as a tract, county, ZCTA, state, or tabblock. Returns normalized IDs, labels, parent hierarchy, and source asset links.

entity_id.description: Canonical entity identifier such as '48201231400' for a tract, '48201' for a county, '77056' for a ZCTA, or '48' for a state.

entity_type.description: Optional explicit entity type such as 'tract', 'county', 'zcta', 'state', or 'tabblock'.

tools.name: get_geography_crosswalk
tools.description: Resolve canonical geography crosswalk rows such as tract-to-county, tract-to-state, tract-to-ZCTA, or tabblock-to-tract mappings.

source_entity_id.description: Source entity identifier such as tract GEOID20 '48201231400' or tabblock GEOID20 '480717106001022'.

source_entity_type.description: Optional explicit source entity type such as 'tract', 'county', or 'tabblock'.

target_entity_type.description: Optional target entity type such as 'state', 'county', 'tract', or 'zcta'.

tools.name: get_provenance
tools.description: Get one reviewed provenance manifest or source ledger by provenance_id. Returns retrieval and publication metadata, benchmark role, summary counts, and any public-safe details.

provenance_id.description: Reviewed provenance identifier such as 'provenance.arizona_archive_status_ledger' or 'benchmark.raw_single_source_registry'.

tools.name: get_data_artifact
tools.description: Get metadata for one reviewed public artifact by artifact_id. Returns format, media type, owner asset, retrieval metadata, and the canonical download path.

tools.name: query_observations
tools.description: Query canonical observation records for aggregate-safe history panels such as tract ACS target histories. Returns standardized observation rows with entity, time, metric, provenance, and access metadata.

asset_id.description: Optional observation asset identifier such as 'context.census_acs'.

entity_type.description: Optional entity type. Current canonical aggregate support is 'tract'.

entity_id.description: Canonical entity identifier, currently a tract GEOID20 such as '48201231400'.

metric_id.description: Optional metric identifier such as 'total_population' or 'median_hh_income'.

period_start.description: Optional ISO date lower bound such as '2024-01-01'.

period_end.description: Optional ISO date upper bound such as '2025-12-31'.

tools.name: query_features
tools.description: Query canonical feature records derived from aggregate-safe observations. Returns versioned feature IDs, transform metadata, leakage-safe inputs, and public training-candidate labels.

asset_id.description: Optional feature asset identifier such as 'benchmark.normalized_training_panels_candidate'.

entity_type.description: Optional entity type. Current canonical aggregate support is 'tract'.

entity_id.description: Canonical entity identifier, currently a tract GEOID20 such as '48201231400'.

metric_id.description: Optional metric identifier such as 'total_population' or 'median_hh_income'.

as_of_date.description: Optional feature as-of date such as '2025-12-31'.

period_start.description: Optional ISO date lower bound such as '2024-01-01'.

period_end.description: Optional ISO date upper bound such as '2025-12-31'.

tools.name: get_panel_slice
tools.description: Get a canonical panel slice by panel_id for one aggregate entity such as a tract. Returns normalized multi-metric panel rows suitable for benchmarks, feature panels, or training-candidate review.

entity_type.description: Optional entity type. Current canonical aggregate support is 'tract'.

entity_id.description: Canonical entity identifier, currently a tract GEOID20 such as '48201231400'.

metrics.description: Optional pipe- or comma-delimited metric list such as 'total_population|median_hh_income'.

period_start.description: Optional ISO date lower bound such as '2024-01-01'.

period_end.description: Optional ISO date upper bound such as '2025-12-31'.

tools.name: query_forecasts
tools.description: Query canonical forecast-series records for aggregate forecast assets such as tract target-metric feeds. Returns origin time, training cutoff, band metadata, and horizon points in a unified schema.

asset_id.description: Optional forecast asset identifier such as 'forecast.tract_target_metrics'.

entity_type.description: Optional entity type. Current canonical aggregate support is 'tract'.

entity_id.description: Canonical entity identifier, currently a tract GEOID20 such as '48201231400'.

metric_id.description: Optional metric identifier such as 'total_population' or 'median_hh_income'.

tools.name: get_forecast_vintage
tools.description: Get one canonical public forecast vintage by vintage_id. Returns grouped same-vintage public forecast series with provenance-heavy labeling for benchmark use.

vintage_id.description: Canonical forecast vintage identifier such as 'az_oeo_maricopa_medium_2022_report'.

tools.name: get_benchmark_result
tools.description: Get one canonical benchmark result by benchmark_id. Returns standardized score rows, evaluation cutoff metadata, reproducibility references, and benchmark-only labeling.

tools.name: get_synthetic_dataset
tools.description: Get one explicitly labeled synthetic dataset bundle such as a public aggregate tract scenario pack. Synthetic payloads never claim to be observed data.

entity_type.description: Optional entity type. Current canonical aggregate support is 'tract'.

tools.name: get_target_metric_forecast
tools.description: Get aggregate tract target-metric forecasts such as total_population. This is the phase-2 bridge between Homecastr outputs and downstream benchmark or training consumers and may be deployment-gated.

tools.name: get_narrative
tools.description: Get AI-generated narrative text for a geographic area (county, tract, city, or state). Useful for report generation, SEO copy, or enriching chatbot context with qualitative market descriptions.

geoid.description: Geographic identifier: same FIPS or GEOID20 used for forecast endpoints. County: 5-digit FIPS (e.g. '48201'). Tract: 11-digit GEOID20. State: 2-digit FIPS.

level.description: Geographic level of the narrative. Omit to return all matching levels.

tools.name: get_county_outlook
tools.description: Get pre-computed county-level outlook metrics: median appreciation, highest-upside estimate, median home value, and a value trajectory array. Updated weekly from ML forecasts. Use for quick county market summaries.

fips.description: 5-digit county FIPS (state 2 + county 3). Harris County TX=48201, LA County=06037, Miami-Dade=12086, Cook County IL=17031, King County WA=53033.

tools.name: list_training_runs
tools.description: List ML model training run history. Shows jurisdiction coverage, EC2 instance types, training durations, and compute costs. Useful for auditing model freshness and coverage. Requires a non-demo API key.

jurisdiction.description: Filter by jurisdiction slug. Examples: hcad_houston, nyc, florida_dor, cook_county_il, seattle_wa, philly, acs_nationwide.

tools.name: get_analytics_events
tools.description: Query product event analytics: aggregated counts by event type and page, plus recent raw events (PII stripped). Use for understanding feature usage patterns and user engagement. Requires a non-demo API key.

event_name.description: Filter by event type, e.g. map_viewport_load, address_search, forecast_card_viewed.

tools.name: get_permit_zoning_readiness
tools.description: Get permit, zoning, energy, and public-record data readiness metadata. Use before building permit/zoning markets or agent workflows; reports verified R2 evidence, gaps, and whether raw rows are exposed.

source_id.description: Optional source id to inspect, e.g. 'census_bps_county_annual_raw'.

market_id.description: Optional market-template id to inspect, e.g. 'monthly_county_permit_pulse'.

summary.description: Return only aggregate source and market readiness counts.

tools.name: get_census_bps_county_monthly
tools.description: Query normalized Census Building Permits Survey county-month rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed permit surface. Use for independently verifiable county permit totals, monthly settlement checks, and builder/market data workflows.

year.description: Optional four-digit survey year. Supply together with month unless history=true.

month.description: Optional survey month, 1-12. Supply together with year unless history=true.

kind.description: Census BPS file kind. Defaults to current_month.

county_fips.description: Optional 5-digit county FIPS, e.g. '48201' for Harris County, TX.

state_fips.description: Optional 2-digit state FIPS filter, e.g. '48' for Texas.

limit.description: Maximum rows to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

history.description: If true, returns a county time series across available partitions. Requires county_fips.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and partition metadata without row payloads.

tools.name: get_fast41_projects
tools.description: Query normalized FAST-41 federal permitting project inventory rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed permit surface. Use for project status, sector, agency, state, and location filters; do not use it for milestone-date settlement until the full FAST-41 dataset is normalized.

status.description: Optional status text filter, e.g. 'In Progress', 'Complete', or 'Paused'.

sector.description: Optional sector text filter, e.g. 'Electricity Transmission', 'Renewable Energy', or 'Surface Transportation'.

limit.description: Maximum projects to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and count metadata without row payloads.

tools.name: get_epa_echo_npdes_sewer_overflows
tools.description: Query normalized EPA ECHO NPDES current sewer overflow and bypass event rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use for event context by permit, state, year, event type, volume, and coordinates; add refresh/checksum policy before autonomous settlement.

state.description: Optional 2-character permit state prefix, e.g. 'IL', 'GA', 'PR', or 'TX'.

event_type.description: Optional event type text filter, e.g. 'Sanitary Sewer Overflow', 'Combined Sewer Overflow', or 'Bypass'.

year.description: Optional event year based on event start datetime or report start date.

min_volume_gallons.description: Optional minimum reported discharge volume in gallons.

with_coordinates.description: If true, return only events with latitude and longitude.

limit.description: Maximum events to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and count metadata without row payloads.

annotations.title: Get Epa Echo Npdes Sewer Overflows

tools.name: get_epa_echo_npdes_outfalls
tools.description: Query normalized EPA ECHO ICIS-NPDES outfall, facility, permit-status, and compliance context rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use for construction stormwater, wastewater, waterbody, permit-component, and current-violation screening; full ICIS limits, effluent, and violation tables still need separate normalization before settlement use.

state.description: Optional 2-character permit state prefix, e.g. 'TX', 'GA', 'WV', or 'CA'. Required unless permit_id or summary=true is supplied.

permit_id.description: Optional exact NPDES permit identifier. If state is omitted, the first two permit characters are used as the state partition.

status.description: Optional permit status code or text filter, e.g. 'EFF', 'Effective', 'Admin Continued', or 'Terminated'.

component.description: Optional permit component text filter, e.g. 'Construction Stormwater', 'Industrial Stormwater', 'POTW', 'CSO', or 'CAFO'.

cwa_status.description: Optional Clean Water Act status text filter, e.g. 'Violation Identified' or 'No Violation Identified'.

with_coordinates.description: If true, return only rows with latitude and longitude.

limit.description: Maximum outfall rows to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and partition metadata without row payloads.

tools.name: get_epa_echo_npdes_sewer_overflow_history
tools.description: Query normalized EPA ECHO NPDES all-version sewer overflow and bypass event rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use for amendment/replacement history by permit, state, year, event type, volume, current-report flag, and replacing payload IDs; add refresh/checksum policy before autonomous settlement.

state.description: Optional 2-character permit state prefix, e.g. 'IL', 'GA', 'PR', or 'TX'.

event_type.description: Optional event type text filter, e.g. 'Sanitary Sewer Overflow', 'Combined Sewer Overflow', or 'Bypass'.

year.description: Optional event year based on event start datetime or report start date.

min_volume_gallons.description: Optional minimum reported discharge volume in gallons.

with_coordinates.description: If true, return only events with latitude and longitude.

current_only.description: If true, return only rows where EPA marks the report form as current.

include_replaced.description: If false, exclude replaced or non-current report versions. Defaults to true.

limit.description: Maximum event-version rows to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and count metadata without row payloads.

annotations.title: Get Epa Echo Npdes Sewer Overflow History

tools.name: get_epa_echo_npdes_violations
tools.description: Query normalized EPA ECHO ICIS-NPDES non-effluent violation rows from Homecastr's public R2-backed environmental permit surface. Use for permit-schedule, compliance-schedule, and single-event violation context by permit, state, year, violation code, RNC status, and linked-enforcement counts; full effluent violations, limits, and detailed enforcement action expansion still need separate normalization before settlement use.

state.description: Optional 2-character permit state prefix, e.g. 'TX', 'IL', 'MO', or 'NY'. Required unless permit_id or summary=true is supplied.

permit_id.description: Optional exact NPDES permit identifier. If state is omitted, the first two permit characters are used as the state partition.

category.description: Optional violation category: permit_schedule, compliance_schedule, or single_event.

violation_code.description: Optional ICIS violation code filter, e.g. 'A0011' or 'C40'.

year.description: Optional calendar year based on the violation, schedule, RNC detection, or actual date.

has_linked_enforcement.description: If true, return only violation rows linked to one or more enforcement-action rows; if false, return only rows without linked enforcement.

limit.description: Maximum violation rows to return, capped at 5000. Defaults to 100.

summary.description: If true, returns manifest and partition metadata without row payloads.

tools.name: list_benchmark_sources
tools.description: List reviewed public benchmark source manifests and their provenance metadata.

include_details.description: Include reviewed manifest details when available.

tools.name: get_api_status
tools.description: Get the current published Homecastr API health status.

tools.name: get_api_usage
tools.description: Get usage statistics for the active Homecastr API identity.

instructions: Use Homecastr tools as factual data sources. In user-facing replies, match the user's formality, directness, and requested depth. For a short casual question, answer directly in two to four natural sentences, usually 35-90 words, with only the one or two most useful numbers and the main caveat. Avoid report-style headings, tables, or repeated verdicts unless the user requests detail. Always preserve the returned geography level, forecast horizon, and uncertainty. The client model controls final wording, and Homecastr tool results must not be presented as property-specific when they describe an area-level proxy.
